voices.note: the mishna of the thirty-nine labours (Shabbat 73a), cited תנן at 70b.3
anonymous redactorial voice of this sugya

props.gloss_en: Rav Nachman: one who lapsed in awareness of both Shabbat and the labours has a lapse of Shabbat, and is liable only once
on the contrary: he has a lapse of the labours, and is liable for each one
Rav Ashi: we look at why he desists -- the liability for a lapse of both turns on it
Rav Ashi: if he desists on account of Shabbat, it is a lapse of Shabbat and he is liable only once
Rav Ashi: if he desists on account of the labour, it is a lapse of the labours and he is liable for each one
Ravina: he desists from Shabbat only because of the labours, and from the labours only because of Shabbat -- the two do not differ
the mishna: the primary labours are forty less one
R' Yochanan: if he did them all in one lapse of awareness, he is liable for each one
how is the case found [if a lapse of Shabbat is liable once]? -- where he knew it was Shabbat and was unwitting of the labours
R' Yochanan: once he was unwitting of the karet it is shegaga, though he knew the lav
Reish Lakish: it is not shegaga until he is unwitting of both the lav and the karet
for R' Yochanan the case is found: he knew Shabbat as a lav [but not its karet]
for Reish Lakish: he knew [the law of] Shabbat boundaries, according to R' Akiva

objections.gloss_en: אדרבה, הרי העלם מלאכות בידו וחייב על כל אחת ואחת -- the lapse of the labours has as good a claim as the lapse of Shabbat; the text answers nothing and turns to Rav Ashi (אלא)
כלום פריש משבת אלא משום מלאכות, כלום פריש ממלאכות אלא משום שבת -- אלא לא שנא: why he desists cannot distinguish the cases

אי אמרת בשלמא העלם זה וזה בידו חייב על כל אחת ואחת -- שפיר; אלא אי אמרת העלם שבת בידו אינו חייב אלא אחת, היכי משכחת לה? -- if a lapse of both is liable once, where does one lapse carry thirty-nine liabilities?

answered_by.gloss_en: בזדון שבת ושגגת מלאכות -- where he knew it was Shabbat and was unwitting of the labours (= p_hmk_zadon_shabbat)

objections.gloss_en: הניחא אי סבר לה כרבי יוחנן... אלא אי סבר לה כרבי שמעון בן לקיש, דאמר עד שישגוג בלאו וכרת -- דידע ליה לשבת במאי? -- unwitting of every labour's lav and karet, in what was he aware of Shabbat?

answered_by.gloss_en: דידע לה בתחומין, ואליבא דרבי עקיבא -- he knew the Shabbat-boundary law, which for R' Akiva is Torah law (= p_rl_yada_tchumin)
